title: PhD Programmes, Faculty of Information Science and Computing (2027/2028)
institution: University of Macau, Faculty of Information Science and Computing
about: The University of Macau's Faculty of Information Science and Computing, which includes a Department of Artificial Intelligence, is accepting PhD applications for 2027/2028. The second application batch runs from 24 October 2026 to 30 April 2027.
requirements: General entry with a master's degree; direct entry possible for bachelor's holders with outstanding grades and research ability

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: Requirement 'outstanding grades and research ability' → objective 'Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis.'

Doctoral level (PhD) → objective 'Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps.'
